note: Photobook Studio runs on the Mac. Shot from `npm run dev` (desktop branch) with PHOTOBOOK_DATA_DIR and PHOTOBOOK_SHELF_DIR pointed at scratch folders and PHOTOBOOK_WEB_PORT=5273. The Shelf holds an Amalfi folder with the web demo's 22 made-up photos (src/web/public/demo/*.jpg), their placeholder EXIF dates (2000:01:0D) rewritten to 12-14 May 2026. The book is 'Amalfi, May 2026' (Lulu, square 8.5 in), linked from the Shelf, drafted with Generate first draft, then given the Travel journal template in Layout > Templates. Replace the book id in url with yours. The Shelf path is shown as the default.
